dukkhita.cp: adj. afflicted; grieved; unhappy; dejected; ailing.
dukkhita.p: [Dukkha+ta] (ti) CL=8 Dukkha+i+ta. Nīti,dhā.19-21. Dukkha+ita. Nirutti.547.]  (1) Poor, (2) Poverty, (a) reached as the status of physical suffering. 4 (A) - see the meaning. (b) reached as the status of mental suffering. 4 (B)  See also meaning. (3) it is to be suffer. (4) Poverty, it is full with poor (suffering), (a) full of physical suffering, (b) full of mental suffering. See also meaning of 2a, b. (5) Related with suffering.suffering is binding. 6.suffering  is oppressive; He. (unhealthy person, etc.). (7) (time, etc .,) when it is reached to suffer.
